mapper.select: SELECT FROM inventory_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_record ( id, inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, record_type, ref_id, ref_no, before_quantity, change_quantity, after_quantity, record_date, operator_id, remark, created_by, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{inventoryId}, #{productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{recordType}, #{refId}, #{refNo}, #{beforeQuantity}, #{changeQuantity}, #{afterQuantity}, #{recordDate}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, 0 )
